independent_review.scope: Opened the cited title, mandate or letter, approval, colophon or scholarly-description loci for all 12 documented stages. Albi and Couserans were re-fetched independently from Tolosana; the images were byte-identical to the lane's, and the notices confirm Res 1341 and Res 1335. Numelyo was in maintenance (HTTP 502) and Google Books returned a CAPTCHA, which was not attempted. The Évreux, Lodève, Le Puy, Autun, Chalon, Luçon, Elne, Angers and Dubarat loci were therefore read on the lane's images, all 262 of which match the receipt hashes. Checked the same-copy claims, all 12 new candidates against existing ones, the 11 dossier gaps, the 22 negative route rows against the lane's search outputs and Dubarat pp. liv, lxxxix-xci and cxcviii, the ownership and hygiene, and the receipt envelope. Corrections: folded the duplicate Évreux and Albi candidates into USUARIUM 7111 and 6876; added the SRC approval decree of 17 April 1856 at Autun; recorded Dubarat's 24/28 January 1544 discrepancy; stated the Bayeux misprint as Dubarat's identification; corrected the Bayonne gap's Google records, the Chalon USUARIUM holding, the Lodève 'praesumpta', the Elne effective-date computation and candidate certainty, the Le Puy distinctness basis, and the Lescar, Bordeaux and Luçon wording. No stage, transition or gap was removed. Not checked: independent Numelyo and Google re-fetches, any body text beyond the cited loci, any collation, and searches beyond the lane's recorded outputs.
